title: Lime's Den of Reviews
description: Welcome to my humble video game portfolio. I used to have a Google Docs to collect my thoughts on games but now that I'm learning programming and forced to learn spec-driven development might as well make something more proper. Since 2026 I've started writing these mini-essay type reviews on Steam. Combining that with my Google Docs I what this site is for. Also you can find my top 20 games of all time and a list of everything I've played.
